name: sats-connect-skills
description: AI coding agent skills for the Sats Connect SDK — teaches agents how to use sats-connect wallet, Bitcoin, ordinals, runes, Spark, and Stacks methods.

scripts.compile: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs
scripts.watch: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --watch
scripts.vscode:prepublish: bun run scripts/generate-skills.ts && bun run compile

skills.name: sats-connect-createInscription
skills.description: Request the creation of an inscription via the user's wallet. This is an Xverse custom method using the legacy callback API.

skills.name: sats-connect-createRepeatInscriptions
skills.description: Inscribe the same content multiple times via the user's wallet. This is an Xverse custom method using the legacy callback API.

skills.name: sats-connect-getAccounts
skills.description: Legacy method to connect to the user's wallet and get account data. Superseded by wallet_connect.

skills.name: sats-connect-getAddresses
skills.description: Retrieve the current account's Bitcoin addresses (payment and ordinals) from the connected wallet.

skills.name: sats-connect-getBalance
skills.description: Retrieve the user's Bitcoin balance from their connected wallet's payment address.

skills.name: sats-connect-getInfo
skills.description: Retrieve information about the wallet provider, including the provider name, version, supported methods, and supported address purposes.

skills.name: sats-connect-getProviderById
skills.description: Select a specific wallet provider by its unique identifier for targeted RPC calls.

skills.name: sats-connect-getProviders
skills.description: Detect installed wallet providers that support the WBIP-004 Wallet Provider standard, returning an array of available wallet providers.

skills.name: sats-connect-ord-getInscriptions
skills.description: Retrieve all inscriptions owned by the user's connected wallet's ordinal address.

skills.name: sats-connect-ord-sendInscriptions
skills.description: Request inscription transfers from the user's connected wallet's ordinal address.

skills.name: sats-connect-runes-estimateEtch
skills.description: Estimate the cost of a Rune etch order before executing it.

skills.name: sats-connect-runes-estimateMint
skills.description: Estimate the cost of a Rune mint order before executing it.

skills.name: sats-connect-runes-estimateRbfOrder
skills.description: Estimate the cost of speeding up a Rune mint or etch order using Replace-by-Fee (RBF).

skills.name: sats-connect-runes-etch
skills.description: Execute a Rune etch order and prompt the user to sign the funding transaction.

skills.name: sats-connect-runes-getBalance
skills.description: Retrieve all Rune token balances owned by the user's connected wallet address.

skills.name: sats-connect-runes-getOrder
skills.description: Fetch the status of a Rune mint or etch order.

skills.name: sats-connect-runes-mint
skills.description: Execute a Rune mint order and prompt the user to sign the funding transaction.

skills.name: sats-connect-runes-rbfOrder
skills.description: Speed up a Rune mint or etch order by replacing stuck transactions at a higher fee rate using RBF.

skills.name: sats-connect-runes-transfer
skills.description: Request Runes token transfers from the user's wallet, supporting multiple recipient transfers in a single request.

skills.name: sats-connect-sendTransfer
skills.description: Request a Bitcoin transfer to one or more recipients from the user's wallet.

skills.name: sats-connect-signMessage
skills.description: Request the user to sign a message with their Bitcoin wallet address.

skills.name: sats-connect-signMultipleMessages
skills.description: Request the user to sign multiple messages in a single batch. This is an Xverse custom method.

skills.name: sats-connect-signMultipleTransactions
skills.description: Request signing of multiple PSBTs in a single request. This is an Xverse custom method using the legacy callback API.

skills.name: sats-connect-signPsbt
skills.description: Request the user to sign a Partially Signed Bitcoin Transaction (PSBT) with their Bitcoin wallet addresses.

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-flashnet-addLiquidity
skills.description: Add liquidity to an existing Flashnet pool. (Coming soon)

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-flashnet-clawbackFunds
skills.description: Recover stuck funds from a Flashnet transfer that was not claimed by the recipient.

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-flashnet-confirmInitialDeposit
skills.description: Confirm the initial deposit for a newly created Flashnet liquidity pool. (Coming soon)

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-flashnet-createBondingPool
skills.description: Create a bonding curve liquidity pool on the Flashnet. (Coming soon)

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-flashnet-createCPPool
skills.description: Create a constant product liquidity pool on the Flashnet. (Coming soon)

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-flashnet-executeRouteSwap
skills.description: Execute a multi-hop token swap on the Flashnet, routing through multiple pools. (Coming soon)

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-flashnet-executeSwap
skills.description: Execute a token swap on the Flashnet. (Coming soon)

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-flashnet-getClawbackEligibleTransfers
skills.description: Check for pending Flashnet transfers that are eligible for clawback recovery.

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-flashnet-getJWT
skills.description: Request a Flashnet JSON Web Token (JWT) from the user's wallet, used to authenticate with Flashnet services.

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-flashnet-removeLiquidity
skills.description: Remove liquidity from a Flashnet pool. (Coming soon)

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-flashnet-signIntent
skills.description: Sign a Flashnet intent using the user's wallet. Intents represent actions to be executed on the Flashnet.

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-flashnet-signStructuredMessage
skills.description: Sign a structured Flashnet message using the user's wallet, typically used for typed or domain-specific data signing.

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-getAddress
skills.description: Retrieve the user's Spark address from their connected wallet for receiving BTC on the Spark layer.

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-getBalance
skills.description: Retrieve the user's Spark BTC balance from their connected wallet.

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-signMessage
skills.description: Request the user to sign a message with their Spark key.

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-transfer
skills.description: Send BTC to a recipient on the Spark layer from the user's wallet.

skills.name: sats-connect-spark-transferToken
skills.description: Send a Spark BTKN token to a recipient on the Spark layer from the user's wallet.

skills.name: sats-connect-stx-callContract
skills.description: Request a smart contract function call on the Stacks blockchain through the user's wallet.

skills.name: sats-connect-stx-deployContract
skills.description: Deploy a Clarity smart contract to the Stacks blockchain through the user's wallet.

skills.name: sats-connect-stx-getAccounts
skills.description: Retrieve the user's Stacks (STX) account addresses from their connected wallet.

skills.name: sats-connect-stx-signMessage
skills.description: Request the user to sign a message with their Stacks account.

skills.name: sats-connect-stx-signStructuredMessage
skills.description: Request the user to sign a structured message following the SIP-018 standard with their Stacks account.

skills.name: sats-connect-stx-signTransaction
skills.description: Request the user to sign a Stacks transaction with their wallet.

skills.name: sats-connect-stx-transferStx
skills.description: Request a STX token transfer from the user's Stacks account to a recipient address.

skills.name: sats-connect-wallet-addNetwork
skills.description: Request adding a new custom network to the user's wallet. The user will be prompted to approve the network addition.

skills.name: sats-connect-wallet-changeNetwork
skills.description: Request the user's wallet to switch to a different network (e.g. from mainnet to testnet).

skills.name: sats-connect-wallet-connect
skills.description: Connect your app to the user's Xverse wallet using wallet_connect, which grants read permissions and returns account data like addresses and network info.

skills.name: sats-connect-wallet-disconnect
skills.description: Disconnect your app from the user's wallet, clearing all permissions for all wallet accounts.

skills.name: sats-connect-wallet-getAccount
skills.description: Get the user's wallet account information, including the wallet type and account creation method.

skills.name: sats-connect-wallet-getNetwork
skills.description: Retrieve the currently active Bitcoin and Stacks network (mainnet, testnet, etc.) from the user's wallet.

skills.name: sats-connect-wallet-openBridge
skills.description: Open the wallet's bridge flow, enabling the user to bridge assets between networks.

skills.name: sats-connect-wallet-openBuy
skills.description: Open the wallet's buy flow, enabling the user to purchase BTC through the wallet's built-in purchase interface.

skills.name: sats-connect-wallet-openEarn
skills.description: Open the wallet's earn flow, enabling the user to earn yield on their BTC. (Coming soon)

skills.name: sats-connect-wallet-openReceive
skills.description: Open the wallet's receive screen, allowing the user to view their address and QR code for receiving funds.
